scope: Read-only intended output and preservation inventory. This is not a hash baseline or proof that permanent setup has run; root captures hashes only after a stable successful setup gate.
comparisonRules: Require all43 intended primary assets and their metadata after first setup; compare actual material filenames rather than silently dropping unexpected entries.
Require unchanged package FBX/license source hashes at the copied Models/License destinations.

After first successful setup, capture every actual file recursively under Household art/prefab roots plus settings+scene+metadata; union with explicit source/template/configuration and existing146 authored-file baseline.
Repeat setup must produce no changed hashes, no missing paths, no new output files and no retained owned temporary scenes.
Do not replace or recapture the established146-file authored baseline to make mismatches disappear.
The source scale conversion is recorded in model importer metadata; raw FBX bytes must remain identical to the staged source.
